title: Lời nguyện
about: Round x4 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm cho tôi"): a prayer in the dark: the far choir and a low organ holding a slow hymn, a singing bowl rubbed under them, the great bell at the end. F minor at 44 bpm. An original piece.
